overrides.event_description: bezuclastinib NDA PDUFA for NonAdvSM (non-advanced systemic mastocytosis) — second of two concurrent FDA decisions for bezuclastinib (first: GIST 2026-11-30)

overrides.notes: pdufa_dates.json already carries both COGT PDUFA entries. This override ensures the NonAdvSM date is surfaced explicitly in catalyst audit logs. GIST PDUFA (2026-11-30) is the nearer event and will be shown as next_catalyst_date until it passes.

overrides.event_description: TEBE-AM Phase 3 topline overall survival data (tebentafusp in 2L+ advanced cutaneous melanoma, 540 patients, event-driven OS endpoint) — guided Q2 2027 per Q3 2026 earnings 2026-11-07, slipped from prior guidance of 'as early as end of 2026'
overrides.source: Immunocore Q3 2026 earnings press release 2026-11-07; Biohedge density overlay 2026-11-05
overrides.notes: Guidance slipped ~1 quarter from Sep 2026 'as early as end of 2026' to Q2 2027 per Q3 report. Date set to 2027-05-01 (mid-Q2) as placeholder; actual timing event-driven. KIMMTRAK is commercial ($102M Q3 revenue); this is an expansion indication catalyst, not approval-to-launch.
